startOfDay()
Perform searches based on the start of the current day.
See also startOfWeek(), startOfMonth(), startOfYear(), endOfDay(), endOfWeek(), endOfMonth() and endOfYear().
| Syntax | startOfDay() where inc is an optional increment of(+/-)nn(y\|M\|w\|d\|h\|m) . If the time unit qualifier is omitted, it defaults to the natural period of the function, e.g.startOfDay("+1") is the same asstartOfDay("+1d") . If the plus/minus(+/-) sign is omitted, plus(+) is assumed. | 
|---|---|
| Supported fields | Created, Due, Resolved, Updated, custom fields of type Date/Time |
